excerpt.text: (C) Despite regulation 10.5.20.40(5), the words lawful, lawfully and lawfully existing, highlighted in bold type, in addition to the definitions provided in Zoning By-law 569-2013, Chapter 800 Definitions, include: (i) buildings, structures or uses authorized or permitted on or before June 26, 2025; and (ii) for which a building permit was lawfully issued before June 26, 2025.
